messages:
maya-cs: Quick sync — just off a 30m onboarding call with Orion Finance. High-level: they love the latency but hit blockers on cost visibility and routing rules for Dedicated. Main asks -> per-route cost breakdown in Console, clearer Dedicated vs Hosted billing during onboarding, and a migration checklist for model pinning.

leah-ops: can you paste the exact quote from the customer? helps for PRD.

maya-cs: "We can't show execs a single line item that explains why a route spiked — we need per-route cost or we won't get the budget sign-off." — CFO level ask. Also frustrated that burst capacity docs are spread across 3 pages.

jenna-ux: noted. UX risk: per-route view needs clear attribution (tokens, batching, fallback). Can we prototype a table with columns: route, model, tokens, estimated $/hr?

darren-pm: +1. We have a stub in the roadmap for Q2 visibility work but this pushes it higher. Question: is this strictly console UI or requires backend tagging on requests?

leah-ops: backend needs tagging. Right now we only tag at model-level and customer namespace. We need request-level metadata persisted in billing pipeline. I can scope effort but will need infra time.

maya-cs: Orion uses multiple routes per product (chat, embeddings, rerank). They want to compare cost by route and by model variant (quantized vs fp16).

simon-ce: from an enablement perspective we can offer a temporary report export (CSV) that joins request logs + model metadata to give them a stopgap view. Low effort: run a daily aggregate by route for the first 30 days.

darren-pm: good short-term plan. Longer term: Console per-route breakdown with drilldown to request sample. Prioritization question: ship CSV report + migration checklist in 2 sprints, and start backend tagging work in parallel (sprint 3). Thoughts?

jenna-ux: agree. I'll design a compact table + a modal showing sample requests. Mockup ETA: end of week.

leah-ops: tagging work depends on whether we piggyback on existing request headers. If so, it's ~3 devs for 2 sprints to persist to the billing pipeline; if not, more. I'll do a quick spike tomorrow.

maya-cs: action items: 1) Jenna make mockups (due Fri) 2) Simon produce CSV export plan + sample for Orion (due Tue) 3) Leah spike tagging feasibility (due Wed) 4) Darren add short-term CSV + migration checklist to onboarding playbook and flag for PD sync.

simon-ce: created a quick issue and uploaded a sample CSV to the shared folder: https://redwood.notionsite/orn-exports. I'll DM Orion the sample today.

feedback-bot: Reminder: please add customer sentiment tag ("risk: revenue") to this thread if renewal is at risk.

maya-cs: tagging thread now: risk: revenue. Renewal check — they said approval for Dedicated depends on seeing quarter 1 forecast with per-route costs. Renewal window in 9 months; high priority.

darren-pm: I'll slot this as P0 for onboarding experience improvements for enterprise accounts. Will update roadmap and send a short PRD link once Jenna's mocks land.

jenna-ux: mockups uploaded: https://redwood.design/mocks/per-route-cost-v1 — feedback welcome.

leah-ops: spike notes: we can capture route tag via existing "x-rw-route" header most SDKs already set. Persistence: append to billing Kafka topic; small schema change required. Est: 2 devs x 2 sprints.

maya-cs: thanks team. I'll follow up with Orion on CSV sample and confirm acceptance criteria for the migration checklist.

simon-ce: tagging for internal owners: @darren-pm, @leah-ops, @jenna-ux.

maya-cs: closing loop — added checklist entry to onboarding playbook: "verify per-route cost export and confirm model variant cost delta".
